name: OneMillion-Bench
intro: OneMillion-Bench 是覆盖金融、法律、医疗、自然科学和工业五大领域的高经济价值专业智能体基准。400 个 Global 与中文任务由领域专家通过三阶段流程构建，并经多智能体对抗验证、同行评审、第三专家仲裁和难度双向截断；论文协议以有符号量规计算专家分数与通过率。
build_method: 专家创建半开放任务、参考推理与量规, 多家族前沿智能体对抗验证, 同子域同行评审与共识修订, 第三专家争议仲裁, 难度双向截断
metric: 专家分数（有符号权重和除以正权重上限并截断至[0,1]）, 0.7阈值通过率, 领域等权总分, 量规类型分数, 经济价值
eval_feature: 逐标准专家量规, -20至10非对称权重, 能力标签与领域聚合
scale: 400题（5领域各80；Global与中文各200）；论文正文称37子域/86三级类，图3与附录B称92个三级标签；固定HF数据每题含11至37条量规
intro_en: OneMillion-Bench is a high-economic-value professional-agent benchmark spanning finance, law, healthcare, natural science, and industry. Its 400 Global and Chinese tasks are built through a three-stage domain-expert pipeline with multi-agent adversarial validation, peer review, third-expert resolution, and bidirectional difficulty truncation; the paper protocol derives Expert Score and Pass Rate from signed rubrics.
build_method_en: Expert Authoring of Semi-open Tasks, Reference Reasoning and Rubrics; Multi-family Frontier-agent Adversarial Validation; Same-subdomain Peer Review and Consensus Revision; Third-expert Dispute Resolution; Bidirectional Difficulty Truncation
metric_en: Expert Score from signed satisfied weights divided by the positive-weight maximum and clipped to [0,1]; Pass Rate at 0.7; balanced domain mean; rubric-type scores; economic value
eval_feature_en: Criterion-level Expert Rubrics, Asymmetric -20-to-10 Weights, Capability Tags and Domain Aggregation
scale_en: 400 tasks (80 per domain; 200 Global and 200 Chinese); the paper body says 37 subdomains/86 tertiary categories while Figure 3 and Appendix B say 92 third-level tags; the fixed HF data has 11–37 rubrics per task

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; source_kind=primary_paper_and_fixed_official_dataset. Paper: arXiv:2603.07980v1, Sections 2.1-3.2 and 4.1 plus Appendices B-C; PDF SHA-256 97b53e25372ea883d5b2b94b39bea73f706caab126eddefdff8188131b1bfbee. Fixed dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/humanlaya-data-lab/OneMillion-Bench/tree/5cf9d5005e2e1f20b4481ed50846161697e82a73; README SHA-256 9590b6bfccff70f6e534c84898beffb28433a89c4e434a8559735b6d29632c41; LICENSE SHA-256 43070e2d4e532684de521b885f385d0841030efa2b1a20bafb76133a5e1379c1. The five test JSON SHA-256 values are economics_and_finance=435a8cf220f1222bf6c52fc3dc08fe15804f8470d53e76ebe3dc93462d69598e, healthcare_and_medicine=ae01a10c17ded86c6c5495c1f77f7cd98b5919de049ae354a03e6c84c590abc2, industry=33ae5f768c3601fdd8a0f1d587a7f2242994e05f54b49346d12714a8a6008d0d, law=50794670a017ee2bf4f4b358191a332d508d59c2a9f993599cdb88838635e887, and natural_science=46b37bd9ab68961df18fa11dada4bef132357ff0abab1ca1348ab281862758c7. Verified release counts are exactly 80 rows per domain and 400 total, split 200 language=global and 200 language=cn. Finance and law use 40 distinct questions per language (80 unique case_id values in each file); healthcare, industry, and natural science use 40 matched case_id pairs per file. Each record has 11-37 rubrics. The paper broadly says the Chinese set is not a direct translation, while the fixed HF README and data show matched case_id pairs for healthcare, industry, and natural science but distinct questions for finance and law; the diagram records the pinned release behavior without rewriting the paper's intent. The three-stage construction is preserved exactly: a first expert writes a practical semi-open, multi-solution, time-invariant task, reference reasoning, and detailed rubrics; multiple frontier-agent families provide concurrent adversarial validation and several must fail the expert threshold; an independent same-subdomain second expert reviews clarity, specialization, design alignment, and fairness until consensus; risky or disputed cases receive a third-expert audit. Lower-bound elimination removes universally solved tasks and upper-bound review revises mission-impossible items. Paper Expert Score sums satisfied signed rubric weights, divides by the sum of positive weights, and clips each question to [0,1]; Pass Rate averages indicators for Expert Score at least 0.7; domain scores average questions, the overall score equally averages five domains, and rubric-type aggregation is separate. Paper value anchors use 2-3 senior-expert time estimates and hourly wage references: total workload value is USD 1,008,370 for Global and CNY 921,832 for CN. Paper drift is explicit rather than silently resolved: Section 3.2 says 37 subdomains and 86 third-level categories, while Figure 3 and Appendix B say 92 third-level tags. Literal pinned-data tag strings yield 35/80 level-two/level-three values for Global and 33/82 for CN because language-local names and current taxonomy packaging do not directly reproduce the paper's canonical 37/92 statement. The paper says asymmetric weights range from -20 to +10, but fixed data contains four +12 rubric entries across one matched industry pair; observed fixed-data extrema are -20 and +12. The HF README's post-paper runnable example uses GPT-5.4, one binary verdict call, and signed-weight division, but does not apply the paper's max(0)/[0,1] clipping and does not implement Pass Rate, balanced domain aggregation, rubric-type reporting, or economic-value reporting; it is therefore an illustrative evaluator, not a complete release of the paper protocol. The dataset is public and the pinned card plus LICENSE declare Apache-2.0; the arXiv paper itself uses CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, which is a paper-license boundary rather than a dataset-license contradiction. EN labels were checked for Chinese characters; ZH nodes carry Chinese semantics; every source-boundary edge is secondary and explicitly dashed; formal drawio/arch/svg/png assets were intentionally not regenerated at source stage. The fixed README Quick Start also filters language == "en", while every pinned row uses only global or cn; a read-only replay therefore produces zero English-filter rows before the example's select(range(1)) step. Formal publication evidence [site-a12b-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2131×865 (English) and 2129×865 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2129×863 and 2127×863. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
